lines.text: God made you to act as his image by representing him back to himself and to the universe. God made you to be his image.
To see things the way that God sees them is to see them as they actually are.
Sin breaks your purpose. Sin violates your purpose. Sin turns your purpose upside down.
Repentance is a spiritual medicine made up of six special ingredients. The sight of sin, sorrow for sin, confession of sin, shame for sin, hatred for sin, and turning from sin.

external.text: An infinite mind does not judge by veils and shadows. It judges by what is true.

external.text: Many that will readily part with their sacrifices will not be persuaded to part with their sins.
external.author: Matthew Henry

external.text: Create in me a clean heart, O Lord. Renew in me a steadfast spirit. Search me and know me, O Lord, and see if there is any offensive way in me.

lines.text: Our passage this morning has one point for us to consider: no one, no one is innocent before God on the strength of what they do.
We cannot truly believe the Gospel if we do not believe we need the Gospel. And not just needing it like, I did need it at one time, but always continually needing it.
The only thing that makes the Jewish people significant, the only thing, is God alone. That's it. God alone makes this people significant.
The only solution, the only solution for us and for the world is the gospel that rescues us from that sin.
